recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中母細胞大量取代正常造血，且呈兩種族群：中大型、核仁明顯、細胞質中等偏嗜鹼性的母細胞，與較小、核質比高、核仁不明顯的母細胞混雜，提示混合表型急性白血病（MPAL），需以流式確認。
features: Marked increase in blasts replacing normal hematopoiesis
Dimorphic blast population: intermediate-to-large blasts with prominent nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Second population of smaller blasts with high N:C ratio, scant cytoplasm and indistinct nucleoli
Fine, dispersed chromatin in both populations; no Auer rods evident
Residual megakaryocyte and a few maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows a marked increase in blasts with relatively little residual normal hematopoiesis. The blasts form two morphologic populations: intermediate to large cells with prominent nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, and smaller cells with scant cytoplasm and indistinct nucleoli. Auer rods are not identified in this field. A residual megakaryocyte and occasional maturing myeloid cells are present. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia with a dimorphic blast population, and in conjunction with flow cytometry are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: AML may show myeloid-looking blasts, but flow cytometry lacks lineage-defining lymphoid markers (cCD3 or strong CD19 with CD79a/CD22/CD10).
ALL lacks MPO and monocytic differentiation markers, and a coexisting large nucleolated myeloid blast population argues against it.

ddx.dx: Acute leukemia of ambiguous lineage, undifferentiated
ddx.vs: AUL lacks lineage-specific markers altogether, whereas MPAL meets criteria for two lineages by flow or cytochemistry.
